style_reference.medium: cinematic 35mm film, natural grain, warm emotional lighting
style_reference.cultural_elements: Ethiopian home interior, warm water basin, Netela, Habesha Kemis, highland morning light
style_reference.palette: warm earth tones, golden hour amber, soft sky blue

shots.keyframe_prompt: Cinematic 35mm medium close-up of an 8-year-old Ethiopian girl with neat braids and a white Netela shawl, gently pouring warm water from a small pitcher over her father's feet in a basin indoors, soft warm lamp light, earnest and humble expression
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle push-in as water pours softly into the basin
shots.narration_am: በልጅነቴ የአባቴን እግር ስታጠብ፣ ልቡ በንጹህ ምርቃት ይሞላ ነበር።
shots.narration_en: When I was a child washing my father's feet, his heart would fill with pure blessings.

shots.keyframe_prompt: Cinematic 35mm medium shot of a kind middle-aged Ethiopian father sitting on a wooden chair in a warm, modest room while his young daughter washes his feet, placing a gentle blessing hand on her head with a warm, pure smile
shots.motion_prompt: Subtle warm camera drift with soft candlelight glow
shots.narration_am: ‘እግዚአብሔር ይባርክሽ፤ መንገድሽ የተከፈተ፣ ልብሽም የተረጋጋ ይሁን’ ይለኝ ነበር።
shots.narration_en: 'May God bless you; may your path be open and your heart be at peace,' he used to pray.

shots.keyframe_prompt: Cinematic 35mm close-up of the 8-year-old Ethiopian girl looking up with trust and reverence as her father speaks blessings over her, warm golden rim light
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle zoom toward her attentive eyes
shots.narration_am: በንጹህ ልብ የወጣ ቃል እንደ ዘር በውስጤ ተተክሎ አደገ።
shots.narration_en: Words spoken from a pure heart took root inside me like a seed.

shots.keyframe_prompt: Cinematic 35mm wide shot of golden sunrise breaking over misty green Ethiopian highland hills and a quiet courtyard at dawn, peaceful morning light
shots.motion_prompt: Slow pan across the sunlit highlands
shots.narration_am: ብዙ ዓመታት አለፉ፤ አባቴም ወደ ፈጣሪው ሄደ፣ ግን ምርቃቱ አብሮኝ ቆየ።
shots.narration_en: Many years passed; my father went to his Creator, yet his blessings stayed with me.

shots.keyframe_prompt: Cinematic 35mm medium shot of a 25-year-old Ethiopian woman wearing a refined Habesha Kemis with subtle gold embroidery, standing calmly and confidently in warm morning sunlight with a serene smile
shots.motion_prompt: Slow tracking push-in as morning light illuminates her face
shots.narration_am: የተመኘልኝ ሰላም፣ ጥበብ እና ክብር በሕይወቴ አንድ በአንድ ተፈጸሙ።
shots.narration_en: The peace, wisdom, and grace he wished for me came true in my life, one by one.

shots.keyframe_prompt: Cinematic 35mm close-up of the 25-year-old Ethiopian woman with gentle tears of gratitude in her eyes, looking softly upward as warm sunlight touches her face
shots.motion_prompt: Slow subtle tilt with soft natural light shift
shots.narration_am: በእያንዳንዱ ስኬቴ ውስጥ የአባቴን ንጹህ ልብ አስታውሳለሁ።
shots.narration_en: In every blessing I receive, I remember my father's pure heart.

shots.keyframe_prompt: Cinematic 35mm wide ethereal scene of soft luminous clouds and warm golden morning rays in a peaceful heavenly sky, serene and reverent atmosphere
shots.motion_prompt: Slow forward drift through soft golden light
shots.narration_am: ከሰማይም አባቴ ሕይወቴን ሲያይ፣ ልቡ በደስታ ተሞላ።
shots.narration_en: From heaven, my father looked upon my life, and his heart filled with joy.

shots.keyframe_prompt: Cinematic 35mm medium close-up of the father in radiant, peaceful golden light looking down with a joyful, thankful smile and gentle tears of gratitude toward heaven
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle hold with soft golden glow
shots.narration_am: ልጁን በምርቃቱ ስትኖር አይቶ፣ እግዚአብሔርን ከልብ አመሰገነ።
shots.narration_en: Seeing his daughter living in his blessings, he thanked God from his heart.
